Each batch uses an already-registered official source path and avoids answer-defining propositions already represented in the 205-question canonical/source-verified bank.

authoring_rule: Enumerate source-defined propositions first, collision-check against all 205 canonical/source-verified questions and earlier Wave 4 peers, and stop without backfill when distinct source-backed propositions are exhausted.
multi_source_rule: Each candidate binds to one registered source_id/version and one reproducible pinpoint locator. Cross-source answer-defining comparisons are prohibited without an approved source-bundle contract.
anti_duplication_rule: B15 must not recreate Wave 1 exact flash-point recall propositions. Prefer autoignition temperature, explosion range, within/outside-range decisions, and same-source ignition-property reasoning.
